summary: Synchronize the existing execution cursor with the Human-selected Planning-Integrity Thin Correction as the only active bounded Work Package, keep #7 as the sole planning source, reject the redundant Planning Baseline representation per independent review, and preserve fresh derivation after closure.

requirements.rationale: The correction synchronizes existing planning/execution state only; no Requirement semantics are changed.

issues_findings.rationale: #73 is the single Human-selected bounded Work Package. #7 remains Planning Owner. PR #72 remains recovery/candidate evidence. The independent review on PR #74 rejected the extra Planning Baseline representation and retained the cursor-only correction.

risks.rationale: Continuity, drift, authority, accretion and false-assurance risks remain applicable. Removing the manually authored planning projection avoids a second planning clock and keeps one mutable planning owner plus one narrow execution cursor.

decisions_concepts.rationale: Human priority authority selected Planning-Integrity Thin Correction first. Independent review falsified the need for a separate planning projection. The accepted candidate design therefore compiles that Human decision directly into the existing execution cursor without introducing a new planning representation.

derived_views.rationale: CURRENT_STATE remains a derived view and is refreshed only to bind its reconciliation provenance to this material activation; planning truth remains in #7 and execution admissibility/current focus in the existing cursor.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: The prior not-derived current-work state is resolved by explicit Human priority selection. #73 is the only active bounded Work Package; implementation is allowed within its reversible bounded scope, merge remains unauthorized, and downstream follow-up remains unselected.

active_work.rationale: Exactly one bounded Work Package is active. All other open Issues/PRs remain unselected unless separately activated by material authority. Closure of #73 requires fresh derivation and does not imply a downstream priority.
